title: Western Museum of Mining & Industry

services.name: Admission
services.desc: The Western Museum of Mining & Industry’s newly unveiled Fluorescent Mineral Display is nothing short of breathtaking-a kaleidoscope of glowing crystals that transport you into an otherworldly realm of color and geology. Each specimen-ranging from electric-blue fluorite to vibrant-green willemite-has been carefully reclassified, cleaned, and remounted to maximize light exposure and visual impact. The installation itself has been entirely reimagined, doubling the display space and improving visibility. Powerful UV lighting ensures every stone shimmers with its own radiant presence.
